prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
competitors_mentioned: Board Certification in Personal Injury Trial Law
answer_verbatim:
I can’t name a single “best” lawyer — that depends on your case, injuries, budget and priorities — but I can help you find the right Houston personal injury attorney for a car wreck. A good choice is usually someone who has relevant trial experience, a strong record of settlements/verdicts for similar cases, good client reviews, clear communication, and who works on a contingency fee (no fee unless you recover).

What to look for
- Trial experience and a record of big settlements/verdicts in car-accident cases (not just general practice).  
- Experience with your injury type (e.g., spine/brain injury, catastrophic, wrongful death).  
- Client references and online reviews (Google, Avvo, Yelp, Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers).  
- Board certification in personal injury trial law (if applicable) or membership in trial lawyer organizations.  
- Clear contingency-fee terms (typical is ~33%–40%), expenses policy, and whether they advance litigation costs.  
- Good communication: will they handle your calls, who will you deal with day-to-day, how often you’ll get updates.  
- Willingness/ability to take the case to trial (not just settle quickly).

Immediate steps after a wreck
- Get medical care and document everything.  
- Preserve evidence (photos, police report, vehicle damage, witness contact info).  
- Don’t give recorded statements to the other side’s insurer without consulting a lawyer.  
- Contact an attorney promptly (Texas personal injury statute of limitations is generally 2 years).

How to find and compare lawyers
- Check the Texas State Bar (for license status/discipline).  
- Look at Super Lawyers, Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell for ratings and client reviews.  
- Search local trial-lawyer groups (e.g., Houston Trial Lawyers Association).  
- Ask for free consultations and bring a list of questions and documents.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the results?  
- How many cases like mine have you taken to trial?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?  
- What is your fee structure and who pays expenses?  
- What is a realistic range of outcomes and timeline?  
- Can you provide references from recent clients?

If you want, I can:
- Look up highly rated Houston personal injury attorneys and list 4–6 options with quick summaries and contact info, or  
- Recommend attorneys who specialize in catastrophic injury or wrongful death if your case is severe.

Tell me a zip code or neighborhood and a bit about the crash/injuries and I’ll pull a shortlist for you.
